spec.title: Object comparisons under JBMC and auto --confirm after the harness reads fields and accessors through one path
spec.description: The proof tier of lib/tests/heap.rs (nine ignored tests): the regression and property harnesses now read a field path through one emitter that also calls an interface's accessors, and compare a String by content in a property's expressions. For a class's own fields the generated bytecode should be what it was; these tests have JBMC prove again or refute every object claim the own checker decides, so a harness that changed would show as a disagreement. Their default-tier proxies passed inline.
